free_parameters.name: opset
free_parameters.why: Restrict the generator's operator set to Pool2d so the official entry deterministically creates the operator whose requires() contains the target branch; Pool2d is the operator named by the finding.

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: Fixed seed makes operator construction, dtype choice and Z3 solving reproducible across runs.

free_parameters.name: init_rank
free_parameters.why: Pool2d requires a rank-4 NCHW input; the generator's initial placeholder must have rank 4 to be a legal input.

free_parameters.name: max_nodes
free_parameters.why: One inserted Pool2d node is enough to execute Pool2d.requires once; keeps the run small and fast.

free_parameters.name: timeout_ms
free_parameters.why: Upper bound for model generation; the single Pool2d insertion is solved in milliseconds.

free_parameters.name: forward_prob
free_parameters.why: Force forward insertion so the fixed call-chain path try_insert_node_type -> try_forward_insert -> ... -> Pool2d.requires is the one that reaches the target.

free_parameters.name: init_fp
free_parameters.why: Force the initial placeholder to float32; Pool2d only accepts floating dtypes, so this avoids a seed-dependent integer placeholder that cannot accept Pool2d.
